# All wards statistics

Every ward's beds in use, stay so far and discharges held up.

## What is on the screen

1. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly.
2. Every ward. Beds in use, occupied and ready for each ward. Group by service or show one list.
3. Stay so far. Average days so far for people in a bed now.
4. Discharges held up. Discharges with something in the way, counted by ward.
